tools.name: echo_probe
tools.description: Echoes a JSON {message} back; the simplest paid call for verifying your x402 payment flow.

tools.name: resume_eval
tools.description: Scores a resume 0-4 against an ATS rubric (impact, parseability, executive framing, contact).

tools.name: agent_readiness
tools.description: Audits a domain's agent readiness against the aptu-readiness-1 rubric (origin headers, robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap, agents.txt, skill.md, JSON-LD, mcp.json, A2A card, x402 manifest), weighted 0-100; rubric: https://aptu.dev/agent-readiness-checks

tools.name: btc_regime
tools.description: BTC spot regime check against a 7-day moving average gate (bull/bear, MA7, deviation pct, favor-entry/block-entry action).

tools.name: x402_preflight
tools.description: Seller-side x402 protocol conformance pre-flight check for a deployed resource URL (schema validation, mechanism reachability, facilitator cross-check, advisory scar-tissue findings) with a graded 0-100 report and per-failure remedies.
